summary: A date field that opens a small calendar, with a text box at the top that reads plain English like "next friday" or "in 2 weeks". Quick picks such as Today and Tomorrow sit under the box, and the month grid below works with mouse or keyboard. It suits agent products where people set a due date or launch date the way they would say it.
use: When people pick one date, such as a deadline, launch or reminder.
When typing "tomorrow" or "in 3 days" is quicker than clicking through months.
When the same few dates come up often and deserve one-click quick picks.
features: The field shows the picked day, like "Fri, Oct 23, 2026", or `placeholder` before a day is picked; `format` changes how it reads.
Typed text is passed to `parse` and picks the day as soon as it reads as a date, while the calendar stays open; Enter then closes it.
The default parser understands "today", "tomorrow", weekday names and "in N days", "in N weeks" or "in N months".
Quick picks from `presets` (Today, Tomorrow and In a week by default) pick a day a set number of days after today.
Previous and next month buttons slide the grid in from the side it comes from, and clicking a day picks it and closes the calendar.
`locale` sets the month and weekday names, `weekStartsOn` starts weeks on Monday or Sunday, and `today` sets the day marked with a dot.
a11y: The field button has aria-haspopup="dialog" and aria-expanded, and the calendar is a role="dialog" labelled "Choose a date"; Escape closes it and returns focus to the field.
In the day grid, arrow keys move a day or a week, Home and End go to the start and end of the week, and Page Up and Page Down move a month, or a year with Shift.
Each day button has its full date as aria-label, aria-pressed on the picked day and aria-current="date" on today.
The month name is an aria-live="polite" region, so changing month is announced.

faq.q: What does "friday" pick if today is Friday?
faq.a: The default parser always picks the next one, so it returns the Friday a week later, never today. "next friday" works the same way.

faq.q: Can I use my own natural language parser?
faq.a: Yes. Pass `parse`, a function that takes the typed text and today's date and returns a Date or null. You could call your agent or a library like chrono from there, as long as it returns synchronously.

faq.q: Why should I pass `today` when rendering on the server?
faq.a: The today dot and the presets are based on the current date. Passing `today` keeps server and client output the same and makes demos and tests repeatable.

faq.q: Can I change the quick picks?
faq.a: Yes. Pass `presets` as a list of a `label` and a number of `days` after today, like { label: 'Next sprint', days: 14 }.
